content: NID NAUNAU ANILḴAD MAMELḴAD ELE DILAG NAI
Nid naunau, ag Naḏinu nai dab menana, ag anilḵad mamelḵad oḏelag dim lamiṯeg! Kobol amuam tutuḵu.

Kayak naip̱a amunu yak laa daaṯe am inam. “Na anin mamen ele binalah mena, a oḏelah dim lamiṯe!” Kayak Nug ḏo laa oh ag tatam maṯom amu ag dim lamidna, keeke ena aoglagnu nai qaḵa ii aum. Iiṯa. Ḏo imup̱aib Kayak Nug diig ma anam heum.
Kayak nai g̱agaṯag qeṯa aum am inam. “Na ḏo amu aṯe bia heḵut amu na haen elab wanp̱a ena daaḵut.”
Am nid mamelḵad ag beḵalḵad aḏelḵad amu ag op̱oḏi bak doomnanu ag toliṯak tutuḵuib maṯeg! Toliṯak nau aib medap̱ig. Ag ena atog noadnana, Naḏi nuhig nai ip̱uanadnana, ib tutuḵup̱a omalaṯeg!
BEGBEG DILAG NAI
Begbeg danab ag ahilḵad gumak danab waalagp̱a dagom kobolp̱a daanna, ahilag uḏat peheṯak heig! Ag oolag aḏitp̱a uḏat aib hep̱ig. Ag Kristus oḏe dim lamidṯeb amubia ahilḵad oḵai dilag ele anam heig!
Ag ahilḵad oḵai amelagnuib, ag oolag iṯag aqaḵunuib aib hep̱ig. Iiṯa. Kristusnu uḏat danab, nug oo oh Kristus meṯa Kayak oḏe dim lamidṯe amubia heig!
Ag danabnu uḏat heṯeb amubia aib hep̱ig. Iiṯa, ag Kayaknu uḏat heṯeb amubia heig!
Aḏinu? Ag dooṯeb, aun nug uḏat ena heṯe amu nug Naḏi top̱a nob ena anamib aoḵu. Naḏi Nug begbeg uḏat danab dilagp̱a amu begbeg danab iiṯa amu dilagp̱a ele anamib heḵu.

Gumak danab ag ele begbeg dilagp̱a anamib ena heig! Ag baḏaknu kobol ahilagp̱a aib hep̱ig. Ag dooṯeb, Naḏi, hab aṯan daaṯe ele amu, Nug am begbeg dilag Naḏi, ag gumak danab ahilag Naḏi ele. Nug laa, nug danab onig oḵai ele, nuhignu ena doonna, laa onig iiṯa ele nuhignu eheḏ dooṯeb amubia iinab heṯe.
BAG QAK NAI
Aria gog tak nai amu inam. Ag Naḏi ele laip̱u daanna, nuhig g̱agaṯag oḵai ele aon, ag g̱agaṯag dayeg!
Ban haknu bala oh, Kayak nug ag Satan eḏidḵulagnu maṯom ele amu ag taḵeg!
Aḏinu? Ig danab ele ban ii heṯem. Iiṯa. Ig ouḏi nau ag aṯan daaṯeb amu wan imup̱an ouḏi nau iḵilag amu ahilag oḵai amu ahilag daup ele ban heṯem.
Amu ag kristen geha iiḵu Kayaknu ban bala tagap̱eg, dimp̱a ag ele ban hep̱eg, ban iiṯa meeb amu ag hip̱aidna daaglag, Satan nug ag ii eḏadma.
Amge ag elele daaglagnu ag imu heig! Ag nai genab, amu maṯagiḏ imualagp̱a tagaṯeb amubia taḵeg! Ag kobol tutuḵu aona, qahaḏ palaṯeb bia ag momolag hep̱eg nauhmananu paleg!
Ag maḏoḏnu Nai Ena hanhan baelag gaḏa bia aḏap̱eg noaḏ!
Ahilag gup̱iḏ, amuam oop̱a genab doyak ahilag amu, ag amu hanhan Satannu lat doḏo ab aḏu ele amu ii aqadmanu aḏaglag.
Kayaknu eḏua awiḵak amu ban danab ag iḵilagp̱a aen hat meṯeb amubia aona amu Kayak nai, nuhig Ouḏi madaṯe amu ahilag qep elab daaḵunu ele aon aḏeg!

Ag hanhan Kayak Ouḏip̱a Kayak Nug ag ehanadḵunu unuqiṯak diigdiigp̱a aṯem aṯem Nug ag ehanadḵunu unuqidḵulag. Ag keeke amu dab menana ag aib niip̱ig. Amu ele ag kristen danab laa oh dilag ele hanhan unuqidḵulag.

Ag da ehaniḏḵulagnu ele amu, ag Kayak Nug nai maṯiak haenp̱a da oḏelp̱a nai meeb, da madiḵulnu amu Nug heeb, dahil baḏak iiṯa meeb, da g̱agaṯag awe, Kayaknu Nai Ena, tatam loḵumak dayom amu, da madiḵulnu unuqiṯeg!
Ao, da nai ena imu madiṯem amunu da mani guiṯakp̱a daaṯem. Ge, da amu madiḵulnu uḏat ele amunu amu ag Kayak unuqidp̱eg, Nug heeb, da baḏak iiṯa ele nuhig nai oh tutuḵunab g̱agaṯag madiḵul.
Ag da aṯem daaṯem, da aḏi heṯem ele amu, ag amu dooglagnu Tikikas, nug am da layalnab, nug Kayaknu uḏat danab genab, nug geha amu oh maṯieb dooglag.
Da nug ihinignu ab dooglagnu, ag g̱agaṯag aqaḵunu ele amununab aaḵu hei, ag gumaṯa goṯe.
Mame Kayak, Naḏi Jesus Kristus ele a maḏoḏ, oo mauhak amu oop̱a genab doyak ele kristen tamaniak danab ah oh madapeḏ daaglagnu ool daaṯe.
Amu Kayaknu ehaniṯak oḵai Nug hamu megṯe amu danab oh ag ihinig Naḏi Jesus Kristusnu oolag mauhaknab dooṯeb ele amu, ahilagp̱a dayaḏ!
